visible.title: Great Product
visible.body: Throttle response has improved tenfold, easy install and opens up way more space in the engine bay. Hardest part was getting the OE intake system out.
visible.product: Airaid Performance Cold Air Intake with Yellow SynthaMax Dry Filter (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.title: Long install
visible.body: I just spent quite a while installing this cold air intake on my 2022 Chevy LT with four cylinder turbo. Issue number one is that the mass air flow sensor harness does not reach the mass air flow sensor after this install. You will have to take that harness apart and split it apart for it to be able to reach the sensor. Number two I had to spend quite a bit of time using a Dremel tool to make the opening larger for the plexiglass cover on the housing so it would fit. Have some driving to do tomorrow so we will see how it performs.
visible.product: Airaid Performance Cold Air Intake with Yellow SynthaMax Dry Filter (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)
